v1_disposition: V1 remains a valid fail-closed selection failure and is not repaired, deleted, or relabelled.
purpose: Run a new fully meeting-disjoint coverage-balanced confirmation on fixed schedule-derived historical meetings after v1 failed before any target result scoring because the frozen June-July window contained no eligible Kawasaki meeting.

schedule_basis.method: Fixed historical meeting start dates were chosen from public venue schedules only, without using race outcomes, payouts, model performance, or odds.

meeting_diversity_rule.prior_meeting_exclusion: Every fixed meeting ID must be absent from the seed/temporal meeting lineage and from the completed independent-meeting batch3 meeting list before PRE selection begins. Any overlap fails closed.

selection_algorithm: Process venues in the exact order listed above.
For each venue, process its two fixed meeting IDs in the exact order listed above.
Within a meeting scan day index 01, 02, 03, 04 in ascending order and race number 01 through 12 in ascending order using PRE racecard parsing only.
Select successfully parsed mandatory-PRE races until the meeting reaches 12 selected races or the venue quota is filled.
The first fixed meeting cannot alone fill any venue quota; therefore v2 completes only if both fixed meeting IDs contribute at least one selected race and the exact quota is reached.

If a fixed meeting contributes zero PRE-complete races, if a venue quota is not filled, if prior-meeting overlap exists, or if fewer/more than 100 total races are frozen, fail closed before dedicated result scoring. Do not substitute meetings or venues inside v2.
primary_confirmatory_comparisons: Aomori versus Yahiko stability on two fully new meetings per venue after batch3 weakened the earlier strong/weak labels.
Kawasaki versus Gifu on fully new meetings because batch3 did not represent them.
Exact 333.3m Toyama on two fully new meetings because first two batches showed severe weakness and batch3 contained no 333.3m.
Exact 335m Maebashi on two fully new meetings as the intermediate exact-circumference lane.
Descriptive exact-circumference comparison 333.3m / 335m / 400m, with venue-stratified design explicitly retained as a limitation.
integrity_rules: No target result or payout access during v2 selection.
All selected PRE inputs and frozen B1a predictions must be written before any dedicated target result-page scoring begins.
No realtime odds requirement and no market odds as predictor inputs.
No post-result deletion, replacement, meeting substitution, threshold adjustment, subgroup retune, or circumference coercion.
Historical pages may be outcome-bearing; v2 evidence remains RETROSPECTIVE_KR015 and must not be upgraded to prospective.
All PRE parse failures before result access are retained in the selection audit.
aggregate_metric_warning: This is a deliberately venue-balanced confirmatory sample. Its overall aggregate is descriptive and not a population-frequency estimate.
